_comment: Enumerates the 7 SecB2B catalogue hosts that MUST be absent from the
loaded CENR observation cache so the CENR-fallback code path fires and
each host contributes exactly one load-time WARNING after 1025 lands.
Consumers construct a probes/cenr tuple where these hosts appear in the
catalogue but NOT in cenr.proxy_hostnames / cenr.vpn_hostnames.
